tools.name: list_articles
tools.description: List articles for a knowledge base with optional filters

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific article

tools.name: create_article
tools.description: Create a new article in a knowledge base

tools.description: Update an existing article. Creates a new version with a change note.

tools.name: delete_article
tools.description: Delete an article (soft delete)

tools.name: list_knowledge_bases
tools.description: List all knowledge bases owned by the user

tools.name: get_knowledge_base
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific knowledge base

tools.name: create_knowledge_base
tools.description: Create a new knowledge base

tools.name: update_knowledge_base
tools.description: Update an existing knowledge base

tools.name: delete_knowledge_base
tools.description: Delete a knowledge base (soft delete)

tools.name: get_knowledge_base_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics data for a knowledge base

tools.name: get_article_analytics
tools.description: Get analytics data for an article

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search articles using full-text search

tools.name: get_article_categories
tools.description: Get all categories used in a knowledge base

tools.name: get_article_tags
tools.description: Get all tags used in a knowledge base

tools.name: create_category
tools.description: Create a new category in a knowledge base. It is listed straight away, including before an article uses it.

tools.name: update_category
tools.description: Rename a category in a knowledge base (updates all articles with that category)

tools.name: delete_category
tools.description: Delete a category from a knowledge base (uncategorizes all articles with that category)

tools.name: list_comments
tools.description: List comments for an article

tools.name: approve_comment
tools.description: Approve a pending comment on an article so it is shown publicly

tools.name: reject_comment
tools.description: Reject a pending comment on an article so it is not shown publicly

tools.name: delete_comment
tools.description: Delete a comment (soft delete)

tools.name: list_article_versions
tools.description: List all versions of an article

tools.name: restore_article_version
